card.text: TOI-1452 b was found in 2022 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Cadieux et al. 2022

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-1452 b"
sources.quote: TOI-1452 b is a confirmed super-Earth exoplanet, possibly a water world, orbiting a red dwarf star TOI-1452 about 100 light-years away in the Draco constellation.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TOI-1452. Its orbit and size follow Cadieux et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Cadieux et al. 2022

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-1452 b"
sources.quote: The exoplanet is about 70% larger in diameter than Earth, and roughly five times as massive.

shape.title: Shape only
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size. No picture of its surface exists.
